assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square premium browser game cover, 1024 by 1024
Primary request: remake the cover image for a tactical bubble racing board game called Bubble Rally.
Scene/backdrop: a floating serpentine racetrack made of luminous glass stepping-stone platforms, suspended above a deep midnight blue ocean with mist and sparkling reflections.
Subject: four beautiful translucent iridescent racing bubbles, distinct cyan, coral pink, amber and violet colors, sweeping around a bend. The large cyan bubble leads in the foreground, with refractive depth, rainbow thin-film highlights, playful forward momentum, bright streaks and tiny water particles. A checkered finish arch in the distance.
Style/medium: polished high-end stylized 3D game key art, physically rich glass and water, crisp silhouette, strong depth, appealing arcade energy.
Composition/framing: square, large recognizable bubbles and curved track, generous uncluttered upper space for the title.
Lighting/mood: dramatic soft bloom, neon rim light, lush blue and turquoise reflections with warm accents.
Text (verbatim): "BUBBLE RALLY", large clean bold playful dimensional lettering in the upper third, highly legible even at thumbnail size.
Constraints: artwork fills the square with no border, no UI panels, no extra words, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: landscape background painting for the playable board of the attached Bubble Rally game, 1536 by 1024.
Primary request: create a matching in-game environment asset based on the cover's beautiful ocean, luminous mist, and sculpted rocky islands. This is a scenery asset that will sit beneath a separately rendered interactive board.
Input image: reference for materials, lighting, color and polish only.
Scene: breathtaking midnight blue open ocean, turquoise and sapphire caustic reflections, tall thin craggy islands far around the edges, luminous waterfalls down a few rock faces, thin low drifting mist, distant mountains on the upper edge, warm glints reflecting from the water. Elevated camera looking down toward the ocean so most of the view is richly textured open water.
Style: same high-end cinematic stylized 3D as the reference. Crisp real material depth, sparkling water, layered atmosphere, cyan illumination and subtle lavender shadows.
Composition: clean broad dark ocean throughout the central 85 percent, scenery mainly around the outer edges. Wide landscape. The actual track and racers will be drawn in code over this background.
Constraints: absolutely no lettering, title, logo, UI, track, path, platforms, bubbles, spheres, arrows, or numbers. No central island. Do not copy the title from the reference. Full bleed scenery.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent 2 by 2 sprite atlas of four racing bubbles for Bubble Rally, square 1024 by 1024.
Primary request: four magnificent photorealistic-stylized glass bubble racers matching the iridescent leading bubble in the reference cover. One isolated sphere in each equal quadrant. Top left CYAN, top right CORAL PINK, bottom left AMBER GOLD, bottom right VIOLET.
Input image: reference for the bubble material, reflections and polish only.
Materials: perfectly round transparent glossy soap-glass orbs, rich colored refraction, rainbow thin-film rim highlights, deep blue ocean and mountain reflections visible inside the sphere, bright white curved specular highlights, cyan caustic glow. Visually rich luminous 3D depth. Each orb is a distinct matching color.
Composition: strict 2x2 equal cells. Each sphere centered exactly in its quadrant: centers (256,256), (768,256), (256,768), (768,768). All spheres the same diameter of about 380 pixels. Generous transparent padding separates the four spheres, no overlap and no cropped edges. View approximately from the front and slightly above.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background across the whole sheet and between sprites. No floor, track, scenery outside the spheres, drop shadows, text, numbering, bubbles outside the four spheres, UI, grid lines, or watermark. Reflections inside spheres are welcome. These will be rendered as animated tokens over the game board.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one transparent game sprite for the stepping-stone platforms in Bubble Rally, square.
Primary request: a single gorgeous circular glass racing platform, on a small jagged rocky island pedestal with luminous waterfalls, matching the platforms in the attached Bubble Rally cover.
Input image: reference for material, color, and quality only.
Subject: a wide thick circular polished cyan glass disc, viewed from a moderately elevated front camera so the top is an ellipse. The glass has magical refractive inner turquoise and violet caustics, bright gold and cyan rim lights, and tiny sparkles. Under it a detailed dark stone island tapers downward, with two fine waterfalls cascading down its sides and wisps of mist at the base.
Composition: one isolated object centered with generous transparent margin. The glass disc spans about 80% of image width. Its top elliptical surface centered near 35% of image height; pedestal and waterfalls extend to about 85% height. All rock and water stay beneath the disc. Clear large empty top surface for a game tile number to be drawn later.
Style: same beautiful high-end stylized 3D materials and lighting as the reference cover.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background, no environment, ocean, horizon, text, numbers, icons, title, logo, other platforms, bubbles or characters. One platform only. No clipped edges.

Create a premium game environment illustration for Bubble Rally: a magical SUNLIT CRYSTAL LAGOON, landscape 1536x1024. Use the reference only for the polished painterly 3D game-art style and spacious composition. Replace the night sky with a brilliant pale aqua sky, warm peach sunlight, wispy white clouds, distant emerald tropical islands and light waterfalls at the far left and right edges. Shimmering clear turquoise water, luminous underwater coral and subtle crystal reflections. The central 85 percent is calm open water with a gentle perspective into a low distant horizon, for a race board to be drawn over it. Keep all islands, large rocks, flowers and detail near the edges. Luxurious translucent materials, rich atmospheric depth and gorgeous soft cinematic lighting, high-end family game aesthetic, colorful but readable. No bubbles, racers, race track, platforms, UI, lettering, logos or words. This is the sunny easy-course counterpart of the reference, visually unmistakable as daytime.

Use the reference only for the polished painterly 3D game-art style and spacious composition. Replace the peaceful night scene with deep violet and navy storm clouds, silver-blue lightning in the far upper corners, wind-swept ocean, stormlit crystal cliffs at the far edges. Luxurious glassy materials, rich atmospheric depth, cinematic storm lighting, exciting high-end family game aesthetic rather than frightening. Distinct from the reference's peaceful moonlit scenery. No bubbles, racers, race track, platforms, UI, lettering, logos or words.
